# Ario pull request / درخواست تغییر

## Purpose, exact source and scope / هدف و محدوده
Issue links, full pinned base/head SHAs, paths added/modified/deleted:

## Provenance / منشأ و شواهد
Distinguish executed test evidence from reviewer statements, mock results, static inspection and unknowns.

## Verification
- [ ] Diff limited to authorized scope
- [ ] Tests described with exact commands, counts, platform and commit
- [ ] Negative/RED reproduction (when fixing a verified regression)
- [ ] GREEN after fix on the exact candidate commit
- [ ] No historical file/digest rewritten silently
- [ ] No tokens, private chats, personal data or real keys committed
- [ ] README/documentation and security implications checked
- [ ] Compatibility and failure semantics reviewed
- [ ] Independent review / owner decision recorded where required

## What this PR does NOT establish
List nonclaims explicitly: identity, provenance, historical truth, trust authority, and deployment are NOT assumed from PASS or successful CI.

## Governance
**Draft by default for research.** A PR description is not merge authorization. Follow existing AGENTS.md, CODEOWNERS and GitHub protections; never assume self-approval or automatic trust activation.
